rules.statement: Every factual sentence on these pages is traceable to an entry in the 'claims' array. A claim carries the official URL it was read from. A statement that cannot be supported is not written; the field is left blank and flagged instead.
forbidden_in_marketing_copy: prices, list prices or discounts (6(y) bars price tracking/alerting; prices are served dynamically and were not obtainable as a stable attributable value)
star ratings or review counts (6(t): only via Creators API or PA API, which this build has no credentials for)
best-seller rank presented as fact about a product
first-hand use, testing or ownership claims (FTC: cannot describe an experience with a product you have not tried)

claims.text: Amazon defines an ASIN as a 10-character alphanumeric identifier assigned by Amazon.
claims.quote: ASIN | Amazon Standard Identification Number: 10-Character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.

claims.text: The three identifiers supplied for this project are 9 characters long, so they are not ASINs.
Requesting amazon.com/dp/ with any of the three supplied identifiers returns Amazon's Page Not Found response.
claims.observed: All three fetched 2026-11-14; <title> on each was 'Page Not Found'.

claims.text: Each supplied short link opens a live Amazon listing for a different air fryer.
claims.observed: link 1 -> dp/B0CDY277D3 (CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven); link 2 -> dp/B09B7SB46R (Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven); link 3 -> dp/B08DKYBTPH (Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt TurboFry).

claims.text: All three destination listings sit under the same five-level Amazon browse path: Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers.
claims.observed: Breadcrumb read on each of the three destination pages.

claims.text: Amazon's Standard Commission Income Statement publishes a fixed rate by product category; the row that names Kitchen is 4.50%.
The same table gives 4.00% to the row 'All Other Categories'.
Amazon requires the statement "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." to be clear and prominent wherever Program Content appears.
claims.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following ... on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."

claims.text: Amazon prohibits describing a product's price history or operating a price alerting feature unless separately agreed.
claims.quote: (y) Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.

claims.text: Amazon permits star ratings and customer reviews on an affiliate site only when they were obtained through the Creators API or PA API.
claims.quote: (t) You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API ...

claims.text: A link may not be presented in a way that makes it unclear that it leads to an Amazon site.
claims.quote: (w) You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.

claims.text: Affiliate content may not promote products offered by retailers other than Amazon.
claims.quote: (z) You will not display on your Site, or otherwise use, any Program Content to advertise or promote any products that are offered on any site that is not an Amazon Site ...

claims.text: The FTC says a disclosure must be hard to miss and that an endorser cannot talk about experience with a product they have not tried.

buying_guide.title: How to choose between these three air fryers
buying_guide.intro: This guide helps a reader pick among the three listings linked from this project. It uses only attributes printed in the listing titles, plus Amazon's own rules about what a compliant affiliate page may claim. No price, rating or rank is stated, because none could be verified from an official source in a form this site is allowed to publish.

decision_rows.if_the_reader_wants: To cook two different foods at the same time
decision_rows.consider: Product link 1 — CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket
decision_rows.because: The listing title describes two independent 3 Qt baskets with a sync-finish control.

decision_rows.if_the_reader_wants: The largest cooking chamber of the three
decision_rows.consider: Product link 2 — Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door
decision_rows.because: The listing title states 26 QT, the largest capacity stated across the three titles. French doors and a rotisserie suit larger items.

decision_rows.if_the_reader_wants: One large basket and simple batch cooking
decision_rows.consider: Product link 3 — Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt TurboFry
decision_rows.because: The listing title describes a single 8 Qt nonstick dishwasher-safe basket with bake, dehydrate and frozen modes.

questions_to_ask_before_buying.question: How much counter space can I give it?
questions_to_ask_before_buying.why: The three listings differ in stated capacity from 6 QT to 26 QT; a larger chamber generally occupies more counter depth.

questions_to_ask_before_buying.question: Will I mostly cook one dish or two at once?
questions_to_ask_before_buying.why: Only the dual-basket listing describes two independently controlled baskets.

questions_to_ask_before_buying.question: Do I need a rotisserie or dehydrate mode?
questions_to_ask_before_buying.why: These functions appear in the listing titles of some of the three and not others.

what_this_guide_will_not_tell_you.item: The current price of any of the three
what_this_guide_will_not_tell_you.reason: Participation Requirement 6(y) bars price tracking and alerting, and no stable attributable price was obtainable at verification time.

what_this_guide_will_not_tell_you.item: A star rating or review count
what_this_guide_will_not_tell_you.reason: Participation Requirement 6(t) permits star ratings and reviews only when sourced via Creators API or PA API, which this build has no credentials for.

what_this_guide_will_not_tell_you.item: Whether a given air fryer is 'the best'
what_this_guide_will_not_tell_you.reason: That would be an experience claim. The FTC holds that an endorser cannot describe experience with a product they have not tried.
